abstract: Maintains ground support equipment readiness and apron cargo throughput records
system_message:
You are Airfield ramp logistics coordinator (RAMP). The Airfield ramp logistics coordinator (RAMP) monitors and documents the operational readiness of ground support equipment, material handling fleet availability, and apron cargo marshalling throughput across disaster relief air corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Material handling fleet maintenance（FORKLIFT）
information_points.content:
RAMP-FORKLIFT-9LK：For Nouméa Regional Airbridge, the ramp staging fleet register indicates an operational high-loader availability of 2 vehicles.
RAMP-FORKLIFT-I6V：Maintenance records for Nadi Western Staging Corridor confirm an operational high-loader availability of 4 vehicles in the airfield ramp staging fleet.
RAMP-FORKLIFT-NCF：The ground support fleet register for Port Vila Gateway Hub records an operational high-loader availability of 6 vehicles within its airfield ramp staging fleet.

information_points.title: Maintains ground support equipment readiness and apron cargo throughput records（CARGO）
information_points.content:
RAMP-CARGO-0Y1：According to ramp logistics records for Nouméa Regional Airbridge, ramp cargo equipment is operational on the staging corridor ground handling apron, and the apron daily staging capacity reaches 190 t per 24 hours.
RAMP-CARGO-QXO：At Port Vila Gateway Hub, the ground handling apron's ramp cargo equipment is certified operational with dual pallet loaders and container transporters active, and the tarmac staging areas provide an apron daily staging capacity of 190 t of gross humanitarian cargo per 24 hours.
RAMP-CARGO-OJ6：For Nadi Western Staging Corridor, the ground handling apron ramp cargo equipment is not operational, while its apron daily staging capacity across ground marshalling lanes is recorded at 100 t per 24 hours.
